candidate.resume_text: Bangalore | +91-9976362271  venkatesh.rajasekar1@gmail.com  I am a dedicated IT professional with over 4+ years of experience in managing Linux and Windows servers. My expertise  includes server patch management, security health checks, and troubleshooting, ensuring optimal performance and security  across IT environments.I have a proven track record in deploying and decommissioning servers in both on-premises and cloud  environments, streamlining processes and enhancing operational efficiency. I am committed to leveraging technology to solve  complex challenges and improve system reliability.  As an Associate System Administrator, I bring a strong background in managing Windows and Linux environments, with a  focus on patch management, security health checks, and troubleshooting. My experience includes:  Effectively managed and applied patches for Windows and Linux servers, ensuring systems are secure  and compliant with organizational policies.  Conducted comprehensive security assessments and health checks, proactively identifying and  addressing vulnerabilities to maintain a secure infrastructure.  Managed server configurations and performed troubleshooting across both on-  premises and cloud environments, quickly resolving issues to ensure system reliability.  Monitored and managed Azure resources, including virtual machines, Azure Active Directory, virtual  networks, and storage solutions, enhancing operational efficiency in cloud environments.  Successfully deployed and decommissioned servers and software in both on-prem and  cloud settings, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal disruption.  Utilized scripting to automate repetitive tasks, reducing workload and increasing efficiency across various  administrative functions.  As an Associate Technical Engineer, I possess a solid background in managing both Windows and Linux environments,  specializing in patch management, security health checks, and server troubleshooting. My experience includes:  Administered patch management for Windows and Linux servers using WSUS and Red Hat Satellite,  ensuring systems are up to date and secure.  Conducted thorough security assessments and health checks, identifying vulnerabilities and  implementing necessary remediation to maintain robust security posture.  Managed server configurations and performed troubleshooting across diverse  environments, effectively resolving issues to minimize downtime.  Monitored and managed virtual machines in Azure, implementing and overseeing Azure Active  Directory to enhance security and user management.  Utilized ServiceNow to manage change tickets, ensuring smooth operations and effective communication  within the IT team. Knowledge of O365 administration tasks involve managing and securing Microsoft’s cloud-based  services, including Sharepoint, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, and Azure AD.  Active Directory, Computer Networking, Microsoft Windows Server, Redhat Satellite, WSUS and SCCM, Azure, Server  Management, Scripting, Troubleshooting,O365 Administration.  Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft Azure  Fundamentals (AZ-900), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
